title: SmartHealth · Operations
description: The five operational metrics per clinic (total patients, appointments booked per day, completed visits, cancellation rate, average wait), read from the analytics views as the read-only grafana_ro role. Provisioned from infra/grafana/dashboards; edit the file, not the UI.

list.name: clinic
list.label: Clinic
list.query: SELECT clinic_id::text FROM patients UNION SELECT clinic_id::text FROM appointments ORDER BY 1
list.description: Clinics that have at least one projected patient or appointment

panels.title: Total patients (ANLY-01)
panels.description: Patients registered (patient.registered) and not deactivated (patient.deactivated), per clinic; a deactivation lowers the count. Current count, not windowed. Counts start at the Phase 3 cutover (D-13): patients that predate it are not backfilled. Source view: v_active_patients.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(active_patients), 0) AS total_patients FROM v_active_patients WHERE clinic_id::text = ${clinic:sqlstring}

panels.title: Cancellation rate (ANLY-04)
panels.description: Cancellation rate = sum(cancelled) / sum(booked) over the time range: of the appointments booked on those UTC days (booked_at), how many were later cancelled. The denominator is appointments booked in the window, not appointments cancelled in it. Empty (not 0) when nothing was booked. Source view: v_cancellation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cancelled)::double precision / nullif(sum(booked), 0) AS cancellation_rate FROM v_cancellation WHERE clinic_id::text = ${clinic:sqlstring} AND day >= $__timeFrom()::date AND day <= $__timeTo()::date

panels.title: Average wait time (ANLY-05)
panels.description: Average wait = visit start minus check-in (the time a patient waited in the clinic, D-10 revised), in seconds, averaged over the visits completed in the time range. Visits without a recorded start or with a negative difference are excluded from the wait only. Empty when there is no sample. Source view: v_visit_wait.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(wait_seconds) AS average_wait_seconds FROM v_visit_wait WHERE clinic_id::text = ${clinic:sqlstring} AND completed_at >= $__timeFrom() AND completed_at <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: About these numbers
panels.description: Definitions and limits of the five operational metrics.

options.content: Read from the analytics projection views as the read-only `grafana_ro` role (D-10). Days are UTC calendar days. **Counts start at the Phase 3 cutover (D-13):** earlier patients, appointments and visits are not backfilled. The same numbers are served by `/api/analytics`. Pick a clinic above; hover a panel title for its definition.

panels.title: Appointments booked per day (ANLY-02)
panels.description: Appointments with an appointment.booked event, grouped per clinic by the UTC calendar day of booked_at. A later cancel, reschedule or completion does not remove a booking from its day. Source view: v_appointments_booked_daily.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS time, appointments_booked FROM v_appointments_booked_daily WHERE clinic_id::text = ${clinic:sqlstring} AND day >= $__timeFrom()::date AND day <= $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Completed visits per day (ANLY-03)
panels.description: One per visit.completed event, grouped per clinic by the UTC calendar day of completed_at. A visit completed without a recorded start still counts here. Source view: v_completed_visits_daily.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS time, completed_visits FROM v_completed_visits_daily WHERE clinic_id::text = ${clinic:sqlstring} AND day >= $__timeFrom()::date AND day <= $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY 1
